        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a conditional check in the `UserGroupInformation` class that incorrectly required the security feature to be enabled in order to process the token storage file. When security was turned off, the code would not execute the block responsible for loading tokens, thus breaking functionality for MapReduce operations that relied on user authentication. The patch removes the `isSecurityEnabled()` check, allowing the token loading process to occur regardless of the security status.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a conditional check in the `UserGroupInformation` class that incorrectly required the security feature to be enabled in order to process the token storage file. When security was turned off, the code would not execute the block responsible for loading tokens, thus breaking functionality for MapReduce operations that relied on user authentication. The patch removes the `isSecurityEnabled()` check, allowing the token loading process to occur regardless of the security status.
